messages:
Casey (AE): Heads-up — VitalityMed POC ready to convert. Legal returned DPA with several redlines and Procurement wants supplier onboarding (SAP Ariba + W-9). Need quick alignment on signature flow and minimal contract path so they can issue PO.

Ibrahim (SE): Security flagged SCIM provisioning + Okta integration and asked for a short SSO onboarding window (3 business days). They also requested an encryption-at-rest detail for our managed keys. BYOK not needed for POC.

Monica (Legal): DPA asks: (1) 30-day data export, (2) subprocessor prior-approval, (3) EU data residency addendum for EEA-subset. We can accept (1) & (2) with a standard notice window; EU residency requires confirmation of regional hosting or SCCs + ent. approval. Liability cap reduced to 1x fees — that'll need Legal Lead signoff if they hold.

Suki (Procurement): On SAP Ariba onboarding: we need their supplier ID, W-9 (or W-8 BEN if non-US), remit address, VAT/EIN, two authorized signers and whether they require eInvoice UBL. They prefer DocuSign and want customer to sign first. Also ask if they need invoice PO-matching (line-level).

Casey (AE): I'll collect supplier ID & W-9. They said billing entity is VitalityMed Global LLC; finance contact accts@vitalitymed.com. Pricing: they want a 12mo committed pool at $68k/mo; ask Finance if Net30 OK.

Gabe (Finance): Net30 OK. Need remit email and preferred invoice format (PDF vs UBL). If they require line-level PO matching, we need GL mapping on the order form. Also request anticipated PO number before invoicing; if delayed, we can accept "PO to follow" but need an AP contact for cash-application.

Ibrahim (SE): For SSO + SCIM note, propose adding to order form: "Okta SCIM provisioning and SAML SSO will be enabled; onboarding SLA: 3 business days after credential exchange." Keeps expectations clear.

Monica (Legal): For signature sequencing: we prefer customer sign -> Redwood countersign. Add clause: "Electronic signatures (DocuSign or equivalent) shall be deemed originals." For the EU residency ask, I'll attach an addendum template and recommend Ops Privacy confirm region availability.

ops-privacy-bot: SOC2 report attached: https://redwood.internal/reports/soc2-v4; EU region availability: eu-west-2 and frankfurt noted (ops-privacy@redwood.com).

Suki (Procurement): Confirmed sequencing OK. If they insist on countersign before PO issuance, note it may delay invoicing. Please collect supplier ID and whether they require UBL/eInvoice.

Casey (AE): Draft order form snippet I'm sending to them now:

```
Order Form
Customer: VitalityMed Global LLC
Billing contact: accts@vitalitymed.com
Remit address: 101 Health Blvd, London, UK
Tax/VAT: GB999888777
Term: 12 months
Commit: $68,000 / month
Billing terms: Net30
One-time onboarding credit: $5,000 applied to invoice #1 upon completion of onboarding milestone (SCIM + SSO)
Signers: TBA (CFO + Procurement)
Notes: Okta SCIM + SAML SSO onboarding SLA: 3 business days after credential exchange. BYOK available for Private deployments per separate SOW; not in scope for POC.
```

Gabe (Finance): Please include finance-billing@redwood.com on send and ask for PO number and AP contact. If they require EU-resident hosting for EEA-data, that'll affect the DPA addendum and may change lead times.

Monica (Legal): I'll attach the redlined DPA + EU addendum template and note escalation path for liability cap to emma_r. Send to them with cc: ops-privacy@redwood.com, finance-billing@redwood.com, and Monica.

Casey (AE): Thanks team — I'll send OF + redlined DPA and post their reply here. :thumbsup:
